---
title: "Check the database and backups"
subtitle: "SOP MGR-11 · Manager manual"
---

## Purpose

Check that the shop's database is up to date and that the shop has a recent
backup, and take a backup when one is needed.

## Applies to

Managers. Check it once a week, before any big change to the shop's records,
and whenever the **Database and backups** card is not green.

## Before you begin

- Admin is open. See [MGR-02 Open Admin](opening-admin.qmd).

## Procedure

1. On the Admin overview, find the **Database and backups** card under **The
   shop**. It says, in words, the one thing to know first:

   | The card says | What it means |
   |---|---|
   | **Up to date · last backup** and how long ago, in green | All is well |
   | **Up to date · no backups yet**, in amber | Take a backup now (step 4) |
   | **New sections wait for a restart**, in amber | A change was merged and the app has not restarted since. Tell the person responsible for the database |
   | **The last update failed**, in red | Tell the person responsible for the database. See [SYS-09](../systems/database-updates.qmd) |

2. Click the card. The **Database and backups** screen opens.

   ![The Database and backups screen](/screenshots/manager/system.png)

3. Read **The shop's database** box. **Up to date** in green means the
   database holds every section of the shop's rules. **Sections in the
   database** lists each one, and how it got there: **When it was built**,
   **Already there**, or **Added by an update**, with the date.

### Take a backup

4. In the **Backups** box, click **Back up now**. The button says **Backing
   up… this takes a minute**. When it finishes, the screen shows **Backup
   saved** and the new backup appears at the top of the list, marked **from
   Admin, by** your name.

### Read the list of backups

5. Each backup shows when it was taken, why, its size, and what it holds:

   | Why | Taken |
   |---|---|
   | **from Admin, by** a name | With **Back up now**, by that manager |
   | **before an update** | By the app, before it added new sections |
   | **before a restore** | By the records tool, before it put an older backup back |
   | **by hand** | From the records tool or a terminal |

   A backup marked **Can't be read** is damaged. Do not rely on it. Take a
   new backup.

6. To return to the cards, click **← Back to the overview**.

## Result

The **Database and backups** card is green, and the newest backup is recent.

::: {.callout-note}
## Restoring is not done here
Putting a backup back replaces the shop's records, so it is done from the
records tool, by the person responsible for the database. See [SYS-08 Back
up and restore the shop's data](../systems/backup-and-restore.qmd).
:::

::: {.callout-important}
## Keep a copy away from this computer
Every backup is kept on the shop's computer. If that computer is lost or
fails, its backups go with it. Copy a recent backup to a USB drive or other
safe place regularly; see [SYS-08](../systems/backup-and-restore.qmd).
:::

## If something goes wrong

### The backup did not work

Read the rest of the message. The most common reason is a full disk. Tell the
person responsible for the database.
